Land an M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB at $500 off, 48GB model at $400 off, more

Alongside ongoing Black Friday in July pricing on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off and $100 off all colors of Apple’s AirPods Max 2, we are also still seeing some serious price increase relief on the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup. Some of the real highlights here are the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro 14-inch model at $500 off the list price courtesy of Amazon and this 48GB model at $400 off over at B&H.

Quite literally the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we have tracked since the price hikes went live, Amazon is offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro down at $2,499 shipped. Regularly $2,999, this is the model with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB internal storage capacity down at $500 off the new list price.

This deal is particularly good considering Apple just raised the price on this configuration by $400 and even before that happened it had never dropped below $2,340 at Amazon.

Another highlight of this week’s MacBook Pro deals is B&H’s offer on the 48GB/1TB 14-inch M5 Pro model down at $2,799 shipped. You’re certainly paying more here for double the RAM, but this is also $400 off the $3,199 list price and a configuration you can’t even buy at Amazon.

Twelve South’s PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My drops to $40 Amazon low

The Apple Find My-equipped Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C Charger is now marked down to $40 at Amazon, delivering nearly 45% off its original list price.

Amazon is now offering the Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C Wall Charger down at $39.99 shipped.

This one originally launched at $70, but has since dropped in price and now carries a $50 MSRP straight from Twelve South. That said, it has largely sold for in and around $55 on Amazon for most of this year and is now sitting at the 2026 low. It dropped to just over $40 for Prime Day this year.

Aside from the unique and ultra-clean aesthetics here, you’re essentially looking at a capable EDC and travel companion that provides a relatively thin wall charger with a pair of underside USB-C ports to juice up your gear anywhere you can find an outlet.

There are foldable outlet prongs for easy stow-and-go action and a 50W output max, but the real highlight is the built-in Apple Find My action. It works just like any other third-party Find My kit, quickly connecting to the Find My app and allowing for the usual tracking and left behind notifications – it is a particularly nice peace of mind feature for a charger unit, especially when traveling and out and about with it coming in and out of your EDC bag.

Dive into my hands-on review of the Twelve South PlugBug for a closer look at the feature set and user experience.

Get in on Black Friday in July Apple Watch Series 11 deals from $299 before they go out of stock ($100 off)

There’s still plenty of summer left out there and if you’re still looking to land yourself a new Apple wearable you might want to get in there while the most popular Series 11 models are $100 off the list prices.

We caught a number of special deals on the more expensive premium Apple Watch Series 11 configurations over the last week or so, but if you’re looking towards the most affordable and, frankly, best value in the lineup if you ask me, the base models at $100 off are where it’s at:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

As of this morning/the time of writing, Amazon’s stock on the base aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models is still sitting at $100 off the list prices. We are, however, starting to see select case colors going out of stock on the larger 46mm form-factor and you might want to scope out the situation before prices start to jump back up on you.

These deals are largely on par with the best we have tracked since release, save for the June Prime Day festivities when select models were $20 less than we have here today. But with the Black Friday in July deals set to start wrapping up over this upcoming weekend, we might very well see the deals on these Apple Watch Series 11 models follow suit and, in fact, we are already starting to.
